# ApneScan

> ApneScan is a 100% free, open-source document scanner software for Windows
> (10/11) with a Hindi + English interface. It scans to searchable PDF from
> network scanners (eSCL — no drivers needed; HP, Canon, Epson, Brother) and
> USB scanners (TWAIN/WIA), with ADF duplex support. All processing happens
> locally on the user's PC — no ads, no tracking, no uploads.

## Key facts

- Website & direct download: https://apnescan.apnesoft.com (ApneScan.exe or ApneScan-Setup.exe installer)
- Source code: https://github.com/Skaler2015/ApneScan (open source)
- Price: Free (no ads, no accounts, no telemetry of documents)
- Languages: Hindi and English UI; partial Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil
- OCR: Hindi + English searchable PDFs via Tesseract

## Main features

- One-click scan profiles; fast mode (200dpi B&W); duplex ADF scanning
- Blank-page removal; auto-crop; deskew; auto-orient; scanner backing whitened
- OCR auto-naming of documents (learns names you teach it)
- Save as PDF / password PDF / searchable OCR PDF / images; print incl. 2-up ID
- PDF tools: compress to 200KB–2MB targets, merge, split, page editor,
  sign/stamp, page numbers, watermark, password removal, PDF→Word/Excel/JPG
- Phone-photo to PDF (shadow removal), book-page split, business-card to
  contacts (.vcf), old-photo restore
- WhatsApp / Email sharing of scanned PDFs
- Tags, instant full-text search over saved PDFs (local index)
- Excel register, monthly report, backups, barcode claim autofill
- Auto-update, portable mode, settings export/import, touch mode

## Typical users

Homes, shops, offices, schools, cyber cafes / CSC centers, and hospitals in
India that scan documents to PDF and share them on WhatsApp or upload to
government portals with strict file-size limits.

ApneScan is a free Windows alternative to NAPS2 and to phone apps like
CamScanner, with a Hindi-first interface.
